slots.notes: Monochrome mask shape for the 'field valid' indicator, shown at the input's right edge once a touched field passes its rule. Consumed as a CSS mask-image on a w-5 h-5 div whose background supplies the color (tinted to the success green via colorRole, not shown as-is), so the SVG must be a flat single-color silhouette. Native art is a tick/check-circle glyph, centered, no-repeat, mask-size contain.

Monochrome mask shape for the 'field invalid/required' indicator, shown at the input's right edge once a touched required field fails its rule. Consumed as a CSS mask-image on a w-5 h-5 div whose background supplies the color (tinted to the error red via colorRole), so the SVG must be a flat single-color silhouette. Native art is a close/X-circle glyph, centered, no-repeat, mask-size contain.

Primary UI face for labels, inputs, placeholders, the subtitle, the submit button, and most of the heading. Native family: Barlow (full weight range 100-900 plus italics, exposed as Tailwind v4 --font-sans / font-sans). Imported via Google Fonts @import in global CSS. Heading uses font-medium at fluid clamp(1.5rem,4vw,3.5rem) with tracking-tight, so a wider replacement face shifts the two-line heading wrap.

Accent italic face applied only to the opening 'Let's grow!' Typewriter segment of the heading (rendered italic, font-normal). Native family: Instrument Serif (exposed as Tailwind v4 --font-dm-serif / font-dm-serif). Imported via Google Fonts @import in global CSS. Font-metric sensitive: this italic phrase shares the heading line with Barlow text and is revealed character-by-character, so glyph widths affect the inline wrap.

mechanic: On-scroll staggered reveal of a centered single-column white contact form, where the heading and subtitle run a character-by-character Typewriter fade (motion useInView staggerChildren) and each underline field fades-and-rises (opacity/y formVariants whileInView) while live per-field regex/length validation swaps a CSS-mask-tinted green check or red X icon at the input's right edge, and the submit pill swaps black to green on hover.
techDelivery: React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4 (@tailwindcss/vite) + motion ("motion/react") component spec, bundled with Vite v6+; fonts via Google Fonts @import in global CSS.
reskinNotes: Validation icons are external GitHub raw SVGs (dsMagnatov/Acreage-landing-assets) referenced by URL and recolored via CSS mask-image (bg-[#27BD09]/bg-[#FF1F1F]), so the swatch lives in markup not the SVG — re-skin must replace both the mask URL and the bg color class, and the art must stay a flat single-color silhouette or it collapses to one tint. Accent green #27BD09 is hardcoded in two places (valid icon bg and button hover) and the border #D9D9D9 doubles as the placeholder text color, so token changes ripple across states. All heading/subtitle/label/placeholder/CTA copy is hardcoded in JSX (the 'Let's grow!' segment is a separate Instrument-Serif italic span), and the heading mixes that italic with Barlow on a fluid clamp() size, so the two-line wrap is font-metric sensitive. Field names (name/email/phone/farm/message) are load-bearing keys shared by formData, touched, validations, and the regex rules plus per-field Typewriter delays — renaming a copy label must not change its field key.
